email.title: Email address
email.description: Changing your address takes two links: one from your current inbox to approve the change, then one from the new inbox to complete it.
email.sent: Check {email} — the address you are signed in with — and open the link there. We will then email {newEmail}; opening that second link is what changes your address.
email.linkAccepted: Link accepted. Your account address is the one shown below — if it has not changed yet, open the final link we sent to your new inbox.
email.linkRejected: That link is no longer valid. Start the change again.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Where your account is signed in. Revoke anything you do not recognise, then change your password.
sessions.onlyThisDevice: This is the only device signed in to your account.

danger.title: Delete account
danger.description: Deleting your account removes it permanently, along with any group in which you are the only member. This cannot be undone.
danger.sent: Check {email} and open the link to finish deleting your account. Nothing has been deleted yet.
danger.webOnly: Open the link on a device where you are signed in to the web application — the emailed link needs that session to finish.

home.title: AI Starter
home.tagline: A full-stack starter your coding agents can extend.
home.description: Accounts, transactional email, theming, English and Dutch, and a guarded LLM chat — working on web and native before the first line of product code.
home.oauthHint: Add Google or GitHub OAuth credentials to offer social sign-in as well.
